description: Khuzait-inspired teal floor-length court overdress over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and gold geometric woven trim. A brown leather and woven sash with round metal clasps and a tasseled hanging end secures the waist. A matching teal wrap rests on the arms; rings and patterned brown flats complete the outfit.
